, a Gujarati student of Kala Bhavana.

description.text: new forms of Indian artistic expression.

description: The design is structured by horizontal borders enclosing a broad central field. Fine branching lines and scattered floral forms animate the ground, while the borders incorporate scrolling foliage, stylised flowers and geometric motifs. The broad lower border is composed of
and curling scrolls arranged as a continuous rhythmic frieze. The flowing lines, stylised vegetation and rhythmic organisation recall the

description.text: visual language of the murals of Ajanta

description: , which had a profound influence on Bose and the artists of Santiniketan. Rather than directly reproducing an Ajanta composition, the design translates its formal qualities into the medium of batik.
The sari also records the movement of Santiniketan's

description.text: artistic culture beyond its institutional setting

description: . Hutheesing studied painting with Bose, music with Dinendranath Tagore, and dance, becoming part of the

shaped by Rabindranath Tagore. Through students such as Hutheesing, the aesthetic practices and ideas developed at Santiniketan travelled into wider social and cultural networks. As an object made for and gifted to a particular wearer, this sari therefore connects artistic education, personal exchange and everyday use, while demonstrating how

description.text: painting, craft and textile design came together

description: in the experimental culture of Santiniketan.
